subject: InfiniteNature-Zero kickoff — perpetual view generation
body: Team, kicking off our productization of InfiniteNature-Zero, our open-source release on perpetual view generation of natural scenes from single images. The pitch for data-platforms: turn any still landscape into an unbounded flythrough for partner creative tools, with no paired video supervision needed. The method trains on single photos (LHQ) with a StyleGAN2 backbone and softmax splatting for point-cloud rendering, which is what makes the training story cheap enough to productize. Milestones I want to sanity-check with Santiago: (1) repro the pretrained LHQ checkpoint and input examples by May 15; (2) retrain on our licensed landscape corpus by end of June; (3) Shipyard-hosted demo for Launch Review Board mid-July. Gustavo owns repro, Csilla the retrain recipe, Saoirse the demo path. Flag risks early — the LRB calendar is biweekly and slots go fast. Thanks, Dmitri
